changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: What a purchase or contribution cost when it was made, kept apart from quantity × price (issue #508). A partial wallet move rescales the origin's lots down by the cost it carries away; replaying cash on the rescaled amounts would hand back cash the purchase really spent. The cash replay and the capital series read this column instead. Rows that exist today keep their current amount, and a lot a move writes on the destination has none, because the origin still accounts for that money.

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Every insert path (new holding, new lot, reinvestment) gets the amount without each repository remembering to write it; only a move's lot is left without one.
